description_en: This operation recognizes South Korean and Indian business licenses. It extracts key fields such as certificate type, company name, registration number, legal representative’s name, and issue date
description_zh: 支持韩国、印度营业执照类型，提供包括证件类型、公司名称、注册号、法人姓名、签发日期等关键字段的识别能力
name: RecognizeInternationalBusinessLicense

parameters.help_en: Image/PDF link (maximum 2048 bytes, base64 not supported)
parameters.help_zh: 图片/PDF 链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: Image/PDF binary byte stream, maximum 10 MB
parameters.help_zh: 图片/PDF二进制字节流，最大10M
parameters.name: body
